name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold development company advancing its flagship Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The fully permitted project completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in June 2026 outlining a 25-year mine life, US$3.0B NPV base case, and 41.9% IRR. The company is targeting first production in 2029 and is at the advanced development stage.
